snippet.title: Karakuri Ninpou (からくり忍法 ) for the NEC PC-88
snippet.description:
Came also out for:

---


Game description:

The girlfriend of the green ninja has been kidnapped! It is up to him to rescue her.

Karakuri is an action game where the player plays as the green ninja and has to go through different houses to rescue his girlfriend.
The player can't simply go from the beginning to the exit, they have to go through various doors to get there first. It is not clear which door leads to which other door, unless the player has played the respective level already.
Some doors also require keys, which can be found hidden in certain walls of the house(s). The player can also find other useful items there.

The player is armed with a limited amount of shurikens, invisibility smoke bombs (no enemies can see you and thus can't harm you either, except for shurikens thrown by enemies) and caltrops. 
Enemies can suddenly appear out of walls and if the player kills a certain amount of enemies a ghost will appear, chasing the player through the whole house.

Killing enemies isn't always the solution, so sometimes the player has to use their wits by using other items or smartly using the doors.
